summary.text: Ron Schutz, a Republican attorney from Medina, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Attorney General of Minnesota to Keith Ellison.

The former chairman of a national litigation firm and a former Army JAG Corps prosecutor, he campaigned on prosecuting fraud, supporting law enforcement and keeping biological males from competing in girls' sports.

paragraphs.text: Schutz began his legal career as a prosecutor in the U.S. Army JAG Corps and later became chairman of a 200-lawyer national litigation firm.
He now practices law through Schutz PLLC and lives in Medina.
He received 45.6% of the vote to Keith Ellison's 54.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
